views.centerline_notes: Axial centerlines through sectioned top and bottom counterbored holes align with the face-view holes. Hatching identifies material above and below the large central opening. No section designation or cutting-plane label is given.

features.description: Extrude concentric annular sketch, OD 11.75 and ID 9.875, to thickness .515. Use datum-A face as axial starting plane. The central opening is included in the base sketch.
Seed .281 through clearance hole at rightmost location, x=5.187 and y=0 relative to ring center.
Counterbore the seed clearance hole .406 diameter by .25 deep from datum-A face.

Eight total instances of the complete seed clearance-hole/counterbore pair F002/F003 about ring center. Nominal angular separation is 45 degrees. Preserve dimensioned cardinal and diagonal coordinate targets; a coordinate-driven pattern avoids treating the REF bolt circle as controlling.

Two .266 tap-drilled holes at nominal center-relative positions (-4.876,-1.774) and (+4.876,+1.774). Opposite location inferred from the depicted diametrical arrangement. Through drilling is assumed pending confirmation.
Tap both F005 holes 5/16-18 class 2B. Full-through threading is a provisional interpretation because no thread depth is specified.
Chamfer ID edge on face opposite datum A, .06 X 45 degrees.
Chamfer ID edge on datum-A face, .03 X 45 degrees.
Chamfer OD edges at both axial faces, .03 X 45 degrees.

symmetry.plane: Front-view vertical diametral plane through ring axis
symmetry.description: Annular body and eight-hole counterbore family are mirrored about this plane. The two tapped holes are not individually symmetric about this plane.

symmetry.plane: Front-view horizontal diametral plane through ring axis
symmetry.description: Annular body and eight-hole counterbore family are mirrored about this plane.

Tapped holes are depicted diametrically opposite. Only lower-left hole has coordinate dimensions; upper-right coordinates are inferred by half-turn symmetry. This is rotational symmetry, not a mirror plane.

concentric_groups.description: OD, ID, nominal eight-hole location circle, and annular edge chamfers share the ring axis.
Each .406 counterbore is coaxial with its .281 through bore, including all patterned instances.
Each internal thread is coaxial with its .266 tap-drilled hole.

equal_spacing.computed_from: Nominal adjacent-center chord in inches = 10.375 REF * sin(22.5 degrees). Eight depicted locations imply 360/8 = 45 degrees nominal angular spacing. Controlling coordinate dimensions are rounded and do not yield an exact common circle.
Nominal diametrically opposite center distance in inches = 2*sqrt(4.876^2 + 1.774^2); upper-right location inferred by 180-degree symmetry.

dimension_chains.description: OD = ID + twice the derived radial width: 11.75 = 9.875 + .9375 + .9375.

warnings: No ASME/ANSI/ISO/DIN standard is explicitly named. Inch units and third-angle projection are explicit; the GD&T uses legacy US notation.
Revision recorded as 2 from latest CHG entry, MAY 23 '78. Earlier CHG 1 is APR 20 '78. There is no separately labeled revision field; the C in 173-C is retained as part of the drawing number.

Datum A is the left axial face in the section. Flatness .0005 applies to that face without a datum reference. Opposite axial face has parallelism .0005 to A; the legacy frame is printed in the order parallelism / A / .0005.
32 POLISH is a localized finish requirement on datum A, not a global finish requirement. Microinch interpretation is conventional; roughness units and parameter are not explicitly printed.
Angular tolerance line in title block contains no readable entered value. Do not assume a numerical angular tolerance.
General title-block tolerances have been applied by printed decimal precision; thread acceptance is governed by class 2B rather than a decimal nominal-size tolerance.
The two tapped holes have neither explicit THRU wording nor drilling/thread depths. H002 and F005/F006 use through as a provisional interpretation only; obtain confirmation before machining.

Eight-hole positions use dimensioned cardinal offsets 5.187 and diagonal offsets 3.668 with symmetry. Upper-left, upper-right, and lower-left counterpart coordinates are inferred from the depicted regular arrangement, not individually dimensioned.

Tapped-hole upper-right coordinates are inferred from diametrical opposition; only lower-left offsets 4.876 and 1.774 are explicitly dimensioned. Confirm implied symmetry if strict manufacturing authorization is required.

Hole instance_positions use the lower-left of the nominal 11.75-diameter bounding square as origin, adding 5.875 to center-relative x/y. This is a circular part, so the reference corner is a bounding-box corner, not a physical vertex.

Reference circle cross-check: 2*5.187 = 10.374 versus 10.375 REF; 2*sqrt(2)*3.668 is approximately 10.37467. These small rounding differences are within explicit location tolerances. Do not force REF diameter to override the coordinate dimensions.
Tapped-hole coordinates imply a circle diameter approximately 10.37737, also consistent with the nominal REF circle within their general tolerances.
Section is unlettered and lacks a cutting-plane label. Chamfer assignments follow the visible section geometry: .06 at right ID, .03 at left ID, and .03 at both OD edges.
Additional non-geometric annotation near the bottom reads WK^2 = .950, with no units. It is not treated as a manufacturing dimension.
Title block also identifies MODEL NO. 320, drawing date 1-21-77, and MANUFACTURING TECHNOLOGY INC.
Angular values D017, D019, and D021 are degrees despite the schema's length-only unit field.
